tools.name: fo_chain
tools.description: End of day option chain of one underlying for one expiry on one date: settle price, open interest, contracts and more for each strike and option type, plus iv, delta, gamma, theta and vega on contracts that traded that day (Black-76 on the same-expiry forward; iv 0.14 means 14%). On an expiry date the nearest expiry is the one expiring that day, which has no Greeks: pass the next expiry from fo_expiries. Required: symbol. date defaults to the latest day with data; expiry defaults to the nearest expiry. A full chain can run to hundreds of rows, so this returns the 40 rows with strikes nearest the underlying by default, up to 200, sorted by strike (meta.centered_on). Use strike_min, strike_max and option_type to pick another part of the chain. End of day NSE equity derivatives from 2010-01-04, no BSE, no intraday. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

date.description: Trading date. Default: latest. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

expiry.description: Expiry date. Default: nearest. See fo_expiries. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

option_type.description: Only this option type: CE or PE, or CA or PA before 2011.

symbol.description: Underlying symbol, for example NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, RELIANCE. Case does not matter.

tools.name: fo_contract
tools.description: Daily history of one contract. With expiry alone it is the future for that expiry; with strike and option_type together it is that option, with iv and Greeks on days it traded. Required: symbol, expiry. to defaults to expiry, from to 6 months before to. Up to 250 rows per call, oldest first. End of day NSE equity derivatives from 2010-01-04, no BSE, no intraday. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

expiry.description: Expiry date of the contract. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

from.description: First date, inclusive. Default: 6 months before to. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: fo_stats
tools.description: Daily figures per expiry for one underlying, computed by TejHQ: put-call ratio by open interest and by volume, max pain, futures settle change and buildup (long_buildup, short_buildup, short_covering, long_unwinding), basis, rollover_pct, atm_iv (implied volatility at the strike nearest the forward, 0.14 means 14%) and iv_skew (25-delta put IV minus 25-delta call IV). is_nearest marks the nearest expiry each day. A long from and to gives an IV or PCR history back to 2010. Required: symbol. Without from and to it returns the last 90 days. Up to 250 rows per call, by date then expiry. End of day NSE equity derivatives from 2010-01-04, no BSE, no intraday. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Maps free text, such as a company name or a former ticker, to exchange symbols with a match score. Required: query, 2 to 80 characters. Returns 5 matches by default, up to 25. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

query.description: Company name or ticker, for example Reliance Industries.

tools.name: screener
tools.description: Filter every stock on one date by its daily metrics. filters maps column.op to a number, for example {"ret_21d.gt": 0.1, "pct_off_52w_high.gte": -0.05, "avg_turnover_20d.gte": 50000000}. Columns: adj_close, ret_1d, ret_5d, ret_21d, ret_63d, ret_126d, ret_252d, ret_ytd, high_52w, low_52w, pct_off_52w_high, pct_off_52w_low, avg_vol_20d, avg_vol_60d, avg_turnover_20d. Ops: gt, gte, lt, lte. Returns are fractions (0.1 means 10%). universe restricts to the point-in-time liquid100, liquid250 or liquid500 members. date defaults to the latest; meta.date is the day used. Returns 50 rows by default, up to 200. End of day data only, no intraday or live prices. Coverage: NSE from 2010-01-04, BSE from 2024-07-08. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

date.description: Trading date. Default: latest. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use meta.next_offset from a truncated result.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Every symbol's bhavcopy line for one trading date on one exchange, about 3,000 rows in full. Required: exchange, date. Returns 50 rows by default, up to 200, sorted by turnover, largest first. Filter with symbols or series and change the order with sort_by. meta.total counts rows after filters. Weekends and holidays have no rows; use status for the latest date. End of day data only, no intraday or live prices. Coverage: NSE from 2010-01-04, BSE from 2024-07-08. No API key needed.

sort_by.description: Sort key. Numeric keys sort largest first; symbol sorts A to Z. change_pct is close against prev_close. Default turnover.

tools.description: Latest trading date published and when the nightly pipeline last ran. Call this to learn the newest date with data before asking for a snapshot or a recent range. End of day data only, no intraday or live prices. No API key needed.

tools.name: universe

tools.name: unusual
tools.description: NSE stocks that did something far outside their own previous 60 sessions on one day, strongest first by abs(z). signal is one of volume, move, gap, delivery, fut_oi, high_52w, low_52w; value is what happened, normal what is usual for the stock, z the distance in standard deviations. Facts about the day, not forecasts or advice. date defaults to the latest day; meta.date is the day used. Returns 50 rows by default, up to 200. Coverage: NSE from 2010. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).
